label: early copy step (recall 1-2) echoing c/a/f in length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at the first two copy-phase inputs (recall_idx 1, about 76% of mass, and recall_idx 2, about 24%), mostly in L=9 sequences (95% of mass; the rest is L=8). The input at that step is nearly always the fed-back original token c (59% of mass), a (20%) or f (19%), so effectively orig(0) or orig(1) is one of c/a/f. The strongest activations are c at recall_idx 1 (right after <DEL>) in L=9 sequences. It never fires in the original phase, at <DEL>, at recall_idx 0, or at later copy steps, and almost never on any other input token. Precision is low (about 10%): most c/a/f echoes at these positions stay below threshold, and no simple extra condition I tried (digit 3 present, in_count, n_digits) separated them cleanly. Sparse: 0.03% of steps.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=a (+4.34), phase=2 & in_tok=f (+3.27), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+3.13), in_tok=c (+2.44), L=9 & recall_idx=2 (+2.43), t=10 (+2.32). Lower it: orig7=- (-2.08), orig4=0 (-1.61), orig8=- (-1.56), orig5=0 (-1.43).
